root_cause.text: The ath5k TX completion path unconditionally wrote the `-1` sentinel to `info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1]` even when `ts->ts_final_idx` was already the last valid element of the fixed-size `ieee80211_tx_rate rates[4]` array, causing an out-of-bounds access in `ath5k_tx_frame_completed()`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE text says `ts->ts_final_idx can be 3 on 5212`, so `info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx = -1;` becomes index 4 on `IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES 4`; the patch fixes this by adding `if (ts->ts_final_idx + 1 < IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES)` before the write.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check before marking the next TX rate entry invalid to prevent an out-of-bounds write.
intent_record.what: The code now checks whether `ts->ts_final_idx + 1` is less than `IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES` before writing `-1` into `info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx`; previously it always performed that write unconditionally.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents an out-of-bounds access when the final retry index is already at the last valid rate slot. It preserves the existing sentinel-setting behavior only when the next slot is valid, avoiding memory corruption or invalid writes.

grouping_result.intent: Add a bounds check before marking the next TX rate entry invalid to prevent an out-of-bounds write.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally writes to the element immediately after ts->ts_final_idx. When ts->ts_final_idx is already the last valid index of the fixed-size rates array, this becomes an out-of-bounds access in ath5k_tx_frame_completed().
